english: Asks for a PIN, password or code
Kiswahili_draft: Inaomba PIN, nenosiri au msimbo

english: Genuine banks, mobile-money companies and officials do not ask you to send or read out a PIN, password or one-time code.
Kiswahili_draft: Benki, kampuni za pesa kwa simu na maafisa halali hawakuombi kutuma wala kusoma kwa sauti PIN, nenosiri au msimbo wa mara moja.

english: Do not send or read out the code. Contact the organisation using a number from its official website or your card.
Kiswahili_draft: Usitume wala usisome msimbo huo. Wasiliana na taasisi kwa kutumia namba iliyo kwenye tovuti yake rasmi au kwenye kadi yako.

english: Asks you to pay first to receive something
Kiswahili_draft: Inakuomba ulipe kwanza ili upokee kitu

english: Scams often ask for a small 'fee' before a prize, loan, parcel or scholarship is released. The reward never arrives.
Kiswahili_draft: Matapeli mara nyingi huomba 'ada ndogo' kabla ya kutoa zawadi, mkopo, kifurushi au ufadhili. Hakuna kinachofika.

english: Do not pay. Check with the organisation directly, using contact details you find yourself.
Kiswahili_draft: Usilipe. Thibitisha moja kwa moja na taasisi ukitumia mawasiliano unayoyapata mwenyewe.

english: Asks you to install remote-control software
Kiswahili_draft: Inakuomba usakinishe programu ya kudhibiti simu kwa mbali

english: Remote-access apps let someone see and control your phone or bank app.
Kiswahili_draft: Programu hizi humruhusu mtu kuona na kudhibiti simu au programu yako ya benki.

english: Do not install it. End the conversation and contact your bank through its official channel.
Kiswahili_draft: Usiisakinishe. Maliza mazungumzo na uwasiliane na benki yako kupitia njia rasmi.

english: Says money was sent by mistake and asks for it back
Kiswahili_draft: Inasema pesa zilitumwa kimakosa na inazidai

english: A common trick: a fake or reversed payment, then a request to 'return' the money.
Kiswahili_draft: Mbinu ya kawaida: malipo bandia au yaliyorudishwa, kisha ombi la 'kurudisha' pesa.

english: Check your own balance in your official app or at an agent. Do not send money back until you have confirmed it really arrived.
Kiswahili_draft: Angalia salio lako kwenye programu rasmi au kwa wakala. Usirudishe pesa hadi uthibitishe kuwa zimefika kweli.

english: Says you won or were selected for a prize
Kiswahili_draft: Inasema umeshinda au umechaguliwa kupata zawadi

english: Unexpected prize messages are among the most common scams. You cannot win a draw you never entered.
Kiswahili_draft: Ujumbe wa zawadi usiotarajiwa ni miongoni mwa utapeli unaojulikana zaidi. Huwezi kushinda droo ambayo hukushiriki.

english: Ignore it unless you know you entered. Never pay or share personal details to 'claim' a prize.
Kiswahili_draft: Usiujali isipokuwa unajua ulishiriki. Usilipe wala kutoa taarifa binafsi ili 'kudai' zawadi.

english: Threatens to block or close your account or SIM
Kiswahili_draft: Inatishia kufunga au kuzuia akaunti au laini yako

english: Fear of losing access is used to rush people into clicking or sharing details.
Kiswahili_draft: Hofu ya kupoteza huduma hutumiwa kukusukuma ubonyeze viungo au utoe taarifa.

english: Do not follow links in the message. Open your official app or visit the provider yourself to check.
Kiswahili_draft: Usifuate viungo vilivyomo kwenye ujumbe. Fungua programu rasmi au tembelea mtoa huduma mwenyewe ukague.

english: Asks you to verify or update account details
Kiswahili_draft: Inakuomba uthibitishe au usasishe taarifa za akaunti

english: 'Verify your account' messages are often used to collect your login or ID details.
Kiswahili_draft: Ujumbe wa 'thibitisha akaunti yako' mara nyingi hutumika kukusanya taarifa za kuingia au utambulisho.

english: Do not use links or numbers from the message. Go to the official website or branch yourself.
Kiswahili_draft: Usitumie viungo au namba zilizo kwenye ujumbe. Nenda mwenyewe kwenye tovuti rasmi au tawi.

english: Contains a link that hides or disguises its destination
Kiswahili_draft: Ina kiungo kinachoficha kinakoelekea

english: Shortened links, raw IP addresses and unusual web endings are often used to hide a fake site.
Kiswahili_draft: Viungo vifupi, anwani za IP na miisho isiyo ya kawaida hutumiwa mara nyingi kuficha tovuti bandia.

english: Do not open it. Type the organisation's official address yourself.
Kiswahili_draft: Usikifungue. Andika mwenyewe anwani rasmi ya taasisi.

english: Promises unrealistic money
Kiswahili_draft: Inaahidi pesa zisizo halisi

english: Guaranteed or very fast returns are a classic sign of an investment scam.
Kiswahili_draft: Faida ya uhakika au ya haraka sana ni dalili ya kawaida ya utapeli wa uwekezaji.

english: Do not invest. Check whether the company is registered with the proper authority.
Kiswahili_draft: Usiwekeze. Hakiki kama kampuni imesajiliwa na mamlaka husika.

english: Asks for a payment up front for an offer (job, loan)
Kiswahili_draft: Inaomba malipo ya awali kwa ofa (kazi, mkopo)

english: A real employer or lender does not ask for insurance, visa or processing money before paying you or starting work.
Kiswahili_draft: Mwajiri au mkopeshaji halali haombi pesa za bima, viza au usindikaji kabla ya kukulipa au kuanza kazi.

english: Do not pay anything up front. Check the offer with the organisation using contact details you find yourself.
Kiswahili_draft: Usilipe chochote mapema. Hakiki ofa na taasisi kwa mawasiliano unayoyapata mwenyewe.

english: Pretends to be a relative in trouble and asks for money
Kiswahili_draft: Inajifanya kuwa ndugu mwenye shida na kuomba pesa

english: Scammers claim to be a family member with a new number or an emergency so you send money before thinking.
Kiswahili_draft: Matapeli hudai kuwa ndugu mwenye namba mpya au dharura ili utume pesa kabla ya kufikiri.

english: Call the person on their old number, or ask a question only they could answer, before sending anything.
Kiswahili_draft: Mpigie mtu huyo kwa namba yake ya zamani, au muulize swali ambalo yeye tu anajua, kabla ya kutuma chochote.

english: Pushes you to continue a job offer on WhatsApp or Telegram
Kiswahili_draft: Inakuvuta kwenye WhatsApp au Telegram kwa ofa ya kazi

english: Fake job offers quickly move the conversation to a private chat so nobody can check them.
Kiswahili_draft: Ofa bandia za kazi huhamisha mazungumzo haraka kwenye gumzo la faragha ili kuepuka uhakiki.

english: Check the company and the recruiter on official sources before replying.
Kiswahili_draft: Hakiki kampuni na mwajiri kwa vyanzo rasmi kabla ya kujibu.

english: Asks you to buy gift cards or vouchers for someone
Kiswahili_draft: Inakuomba ununue kadi za zawadi au vocha kwa ajili ya mtu

english: Scammers pose as a boss or official and ask for gift-card codes because they are hard to trace or reverse.
Kiswahili_draft: Matapeli hujifanya kuwa mkuu wa kazi au afisa na kuomba misimbo ya kadi za zawadi kwa sababu ni vigumu kufuatilia au kurudisha.

english: Do not buy or send codes. Confirm the request face to face or by calling the person on a number you already know.
Kiswahili_draft: Usinunue wala kutuma misimbo. Thibitisha ombi ana kwa ana au kwa kumpigia mtu huyo kwa namba unayoijua tayari.

english: Uses time pressure
Kiswahili_draft: Inatumia shinikizo la muda

english: Urgency alone is common in normal messages. It matters only when combined with other warning signs.
Kiswahili_draft: Haraka peke yake ni jambo la kawaida kwenye jumbe za kawaida. Ni muhimu pale tu inapoambatana na dalili nyingine.

english: Take a minute to check before acting.
Kiswahili_draft: Chukua dakika moja kuhakiki kabla ya kutenda.

english: Asks you to keep it secret
Kiswahili_draft: Inakuomba uweke siri

english: Scammers often ask for secrecy so family or friends cannot warn you.
Kiswahili_draft: Matapeli mara nyingi huomba siri ili familia au marafiki wasikuonye.

english: Talk to someone you trust before acting.
Kiswahili_draft: Zungumza na mtu unayemwamini kabla ya kutenda.

english: Contains a link
Kiswahili_draft: Ina kiungo

english: Most messages with links are harmless; links matter when other warning signs are present.
Kiswahili_draft: Jumbe nyingi zenye viungo hazina madhara; viungo ni muhimu pale kuna dalili nyingine.

english: Prefer typing official addresses yourself.
Kiswahili_draft: Afadhali andika mwenyewe anwani rasmi.

english: No known warning signs detected
Kiswahili_draft: Hakuna dalili za tahadhari zinazojulikana zilizogunduliwa

english: Verify before acting
Kiswahili_draft: Hakiki kabla ya kutenda

english: Multiple high-risk indicators detected
Kiswahili_draft: Viashiria vingi vya hatari kubwa vimegunduliwa

english: This is a decision aid, not a guarantee. A message with no warning signs can still be a scam.
Kiswahili_draft: Hiki ni kisaidizi cha uamuzi, si dhamana. Ujumbe usio na dalili bado unaweza kuwa utapeli.

english: Do not click links or call numbers from a message you did not expect.
Kiswahili_draft: Usibonyeze viungo wala kupiga namba zilizo kwenye ujumbe usioutarajia.

english: Never share a PIN, password or one-time code with anyone.
Kiswahili_draft: Kamwe usishiriki PIN, nenosiri au msimbo wa mara moja na mtu yeyote.

english: Contact the organisation using details from its official website, card or branch.
Kiswahili_draft: Wasiliana na taasisi kwa kutumia taarifa za tovuti yake rasmi, kadi yako au tawi.

english: Talk to someone you trust before sending money.
Kiswahili_draft: Zungumza na mtu unayemwamini kabla ya kutuma pesa.

english: Check a message before you click, pay or share a code.
Kiswahili_draft: Hakiki ujumbe kabla ya kubonyeza, kulipa au kutoa msimbo.

english: About KinyaShield RW
Kiswahili_draft: Kuhusu KinyaShield RW

english: KinyaShield explains why a message may be suspicious, in English, French, Kinyarwanda and Kiswahili.
Kiswahili_draft: KinyaShield inaeleza kwa nini ujumbe unaweza kuwa wa kutiliwa shaka, kwa Kiingereza, Kifaransa, Kinyarwanda na Kiswahili.

english: It uses written rules you can read, not a hidden model. Every warning shows the exact words that caused it.
Kiswahili_draft: Inatumia kanuni zilizoandikwa unazoweza kusoma, si modeli iliyofichwa. Kila tahadhari inaonyesha maneno halisi yaliyoisababisha.

english: It is a decision aid. It cannot prove a message is safe, and it can miss new tricks, especially messages that sound normal.
Kiswahili_draft: Ni kisaidizi cha uamuzi. Haiwezi kuthibitisha kuwa ujumbe ni salama, na inaweza kukosa mbinu mpya, hasa jumbe zinazosikika za kawaida.

english: Rules and wording in French, Kinyarwanda and Kiswahili are drafts until fluent speakers have reviewed them.
Kiswahili_draft: Kanuni na maneno ya Kifaransa, Kinyarwanda na Kiswahili ni rasimu hadi wazungumzaji fasaha wazikague.

english: Tested only on short fictional messages written by the project owner. Real-world accuracy is not yet known.
Kiswahili_draft: Imejaribiwa kwa jumbe fupi za kubuni zilizoandikwa na mmiliki wa mradi pekee. Usahihi wa matumizi halisi bado haujulikani.

Kiswahili_draft: Tafuta mwenyewe mawasiliano kwenye tovuti rasmi. Programu hii haionyeshi namba za simu kwa makusudi.
